cover.title: a checkout that loses half of europe

inner.title: cards are only half
inner.body: cards were 48% of online payments in the euro area in 2024, says the ecb. a card-only checkout ignores the other half.
inner.label: 48% by card

inner.title: add one-click
inner.body: 78% of european shoppers say apple pay or google pay makes them likelier to buy. yet 89% of checkouts stripe studied had no apple pay.
inner.label: 89% missing

inner.title: show the full price
inner.body: eu rules say the total price, taxes and charges included, must be shown up front. shipping added after the purchase has already been refunded.
inner.label: refund due

inner.title: drop the card fee
inner.body: the eu says traders can't charge extra for paying by debit or credit card, with narrow exceptions. that last-step fee isn't margin.
inner.label: not allowed

inner.title: beat two minutes
inner.body: 62% of european shoppers abandon a purchase that takes over 2 minutes. the average european checkout takes 3.3.
inner.label: 3.3 minutes
